goal: Determine whether the frozen Stage-12d MFI-Edge signature controller generalizes beyond UDED, while preserving strict separation between development data and external/final test data.
success_criteria: A frozen Stage-12d representative is evaluated without tuning on BSDS500 external test.
The same frozen family is independently replicated on another external dataset/protocol such as BIPED without using BSDS test feedback for tuning.
Any publication-grade BSDS claim is reproduced with the official Berkeley evaluation protocol before promotion to main.
Runtime, resolution policy, qualitative outputs, exact frozen configuration, and calibration source are documented.

optimization_policy.rule: Never choose or alter hyperparameters, descriptors, thresholds, or architecture using an external/final test result.

stop_conditions: Codex requires a protected scientific-file change
no scientifically valid allow-listed next experiment exists
a dataset/evaluator ambiguity requires human methodological review
